newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Promet calls off Indon firm buy plan.
newsitem.headline: Promet calls off Indon firm buy plan.

text.p: Malaysian maritime and engineering concern Promet Bhd said on Tuesday it has called off a plan to buy a stake in an Indonesian offshore oil and gas frabrication firm.
The statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange did not mention the reason for cancelling the planned acquisition of a 30 percent stake in P.T. Gunanusa Utama Fabricators for $1.2 million.
Early this month, the control of Promet changed hands from businessman Soh Chee Wen to upcoming corporate figure, Ling Hee Leong, son of Transport Minister Ling Liong Sik.
The younger Ling bought a 17 percent stake in Promet for 350 million ringgit in cash.
